confirmedIssues.mechanism: Frontend advances offset by limit and serializes it unchanged. Handler subtracts one from positive offset; service forwards directly to SQL OFFSET. offset=100 reads SQL offset=99, overlapping the first page while the caption claims item 101. Additionally an empty later page renders Showing 0–offset because only from is reset.
confirmedIssues.repro: With a stable synthetic ordered list and limit=100, request pages at offsets 0/100/200: second page begins with the previous page's last row. Request an empty positive offset: caption displays 0–that offset.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; source-derived, no backend request or database access
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Integration owner aligns zero-based offsets and focused boundary coverage; page owner corrects the empty ordinal caption. Do not conceal the API bug through a display-only offset.
confirmedIssues.history: Previously recorded in audit-page-005; current exact handler/page/repo were independently read and remain defective.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-045; bounded verification is not whole-ledger integrity
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The hint promises every row_hash and the badge reports Chain intact, including rows_checked=0. Actual request is limit=1000 with default last-30-days since, excludes null hashes and checks individual hash recomputation oldest-first. Returned since/limit are not displayed. The loop does not establish predecessor continuity between adjacent stored rows.
confirmedIssues.repro: Use a synthetic empty verification result: intact=true/rows_checked=0 yields success. With more than 1000 hashed events in the default window or older events, the same whole-chain wording appears despite unchecked rows.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Show response scope/limit/checked count and retained result age; describe bounded row-hash verification; render zero checked as no verification evidence. Preserve broken/first_bad_id/explicit GET and avoid inventing continuity guarantees.
confirmedIssues.history: Retained Phase0 finding; unchanged integrity component hash verified.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: exportRow emits entity_type/entity_id/trace_id and audit metadata, but DataTable projects only visible column keys. Columns use entity/trace/expand, absent from exportRow, so those become null. ID/IP/user_agent/hash metadata is discarded by projection; before/after are not supplied at all. CSV and JSON follow the same projection.
confirmedIssues.repro: Export a synthetic row with nonempty entity and trace using default visible columns: entity/trace/expand export as blank/null and supplied metadata never reaches downloaded records.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Page owner uses existing onExport with raw scoped records or aligns exportValue/keys with an explicit complete export contract. Keep tableId and truthful loaded-page scope; do not invent exportAll.
confirmedIssues.history: Retained Phase0 finding; current DataTable projection read, not assumed from the old report.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Admin handlers emit {error:{code,message}} via httputil.RespondError. Both direct parseError and resilientFetch read a top-level code; fallback passes the nested error object as the ApiError message. Missing-subsystem code is lost, so the page's improved exact 503+SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED check cannot recognize the actual backend response.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-contract fixture: a 503 body containing nested error.code=SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED and error.message. The direct/fallback parsers do not extract that code; final ApiError.code is undefined and the unsupported notice is not selected.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; no actual request, mocked transport execution or real deployment identity
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Assigned shared request/resilience owner supports nested and existing flat errors without weakening code checks. Add focused synthetic transport/page coverage in a separate authorized fix item.
confirmedIssues.historicalCorrection: The old any-503 page classification is fixed by the page override at lines 31-38, although stale classification remains in the controller. Do NOT report the page as still misclassifying every generic 503. Existing page tests mock request with prebuilt ApiError and therefore do not establish real envelope compatibility: web\src\features\admin\pages\AuditLogPage.test.tsx:12-27.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Before/After are []byte, not json.RawMessage. Standard encoding/json used by Respond serializes nonempty byte slices as base64 strings. Client camelCaseKeys preserves scalar strings; fetchEnvelope only unwraps. ExpandedDetail JSON.parse therefore fails on encoded JSON and falls back to displaying base64 instead of original JSON evidence.
confirmedIssues.repro: Synthetic persisted before/after bytes containing a small JSON object are encoded by the shown success-response path into base64, then displayed unchanged by the fallback formatter.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; standard serializer/source mechanism only, no HTTP or DB execution
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Integration owner chooses/documentedly tests one exact payload representation, preserving raw evidence and explicit invalid/missing states. Existing tests supply plaintext JSON strings and do not exercise backend serialization.
confirmedIssues.historicalCorrection: Old report treated encoding as a candidate because response/client internals were uninspected; those exact internals were read here. Actual deployed payload remains NOTRUN.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Explicit mobileColumns includes action/success/ts only. DataTable applies hidden md:table-cell to all other keys even after column-menu visibility changes. Expanded detail exposes IP/user-agent/trace/hash/before/after, but does not recover actor/category/entity/detail. No mobilePresentation adapter is supplied.
confirmedIssues.repro: At any viewport below md, inspect a synthetic populated row and open its built-in expander: actor/category/entity/detail have no rendered mobile detail path. Selecting those columns in the menu does not remove the mobile allow-list CSS.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; CSS and rendered-field source trace, not measured mobile pixels
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Page/expanded-detail owner adopts existing mobilePresentation or complete expanded metadata. Preserve every desktop field/action, row identity, export and independent paging.
confirmedIssues.history: Retained Phase0 finding, now including source proof that column-menu selection cannot override mobileColumns.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026; paused initial load is not authoritative empty
confirmedIssues.mechanism: For no-data/pending/fetchStatus=paused, isLoading/isFetching are false and no fatal error exists. Entries bypass skeleton and show No rows match before any result. After a paused first Verify refetch, integrity has no data/error/isFetching; the page excludes that source at line 52 and the panel returns the idle hint, hiding the requested paused verification.
confirmedIssues.repro: Provide the valid no-data pending/paused query state on first offline mount; list says no match. Request Verify while that initial verification is paused; verify source is omitted and its body still describes an unrequested idle action.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; branch evaluation from source, no browser offline simulation
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Assigned page/controller/components owner distinguishes initial pending/paused from successful empty and tracks whether explicit verification has been requested. Reuse isRefreshBlocked/source notices, retain true idle behavior and do not invent server failure.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-032/MDC-046; one workspace date owner and scope restoration
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Dated audit list retains page-local Since/Until state and controls; actual /admin/audit-log is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS and controller does not consume useRangeState or URL bounds. These dates scope the displayed ledger, not an independent business-date form. Leaving/remounting loses all local filter state.
confirmedIssues.repro: Set ledger dates, navigate away/back: local state reinitializes empty and no header/URL-backed range restores it.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; source contract and initialization trace
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Integration owner coordinates workspaceScope/controller/filter adoption with both server bounds and explicit default compatibility. Preserve unbounded initial ledger access and minute-level custom scopes; do not silently impose a seven-day default or add a vehicle selector.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Columns call unbound lib formatDateTime/formatRelative with no locale/tz options. Absolute date uses browser locale/timezone rather than saved settings; recent relative strings are hardcoded English in the utility. Filter Date.parse likewise uses host-local datetime with no explicit saved-zone interpretation.
confirmedIssues.repro: With saved UTC/non-browser locale and a different browser zone/locale, absolute audit timestamps still use browser defaults; a recent timestamp produces English relative text even when the UI language is not English.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; no preferences changed, no locale/timezone runtime capture
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Page/shared-date owners use existing preference-aware formatting and localized relative phrases. Coordinate filter zone semantics with AL008; preserve original UTC wire instants.
confirmedIssues.caveat: 12/24-hour behavior and DST transitions were not exercised and are not independently certified.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-023/MDC-040; single disclosure owner with state semantics
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The custom Details/Hide column duplicates DataTable's built-in leading expander for the same controlled expandedKeys. Custom Button has neither aria-expanded nor a target relationship; the built-in expander does expose aria-expanded. Default desktop presents two expansion controls.
confirmedIssues.repro: On a synthetic desktop row, tab through the leading Expand row and later Details button: both toggle the same content; the latter's accessibility attributes do not identify disclosure state.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN; source/ARIA attributes only, no keyboard or screen-reader run
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Page owner consolidates on the existing shared expansion control, preserving discoverable localized Details behavior and all mobile reachability; do not create another disclosure primitive.
